querystring.select: SELECT B.DESCR AS IdType, ID_NO AS IdNo, A.LICENSE_NO AS LicenseNo, A.ESTABLISHMENT_DT AS EstablishmentDt, A.PARTNERSHIP_DT AS PartnershipDt, A.VENDOR_RATING AS VendorRating, A.EMAIL AS Email, A.MOBILE_PHN_NO_1 AS Mp1, A.MOBILE_PHN_NO_2 AS Mp2
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.MR_ID_TYPE_CODE = B.MASTER_CODE
querystring.where: WHERE A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS = N'BRANCH' AND A.VENDOR_ID = {0} AND B.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'ID_TYPE_VENDOR'
